controls.expected: Accept M, C, E or U only; retain the original code.
Preserve detailed codes such as ETS, IPCC, MAB, PER, SSC and ISO variants; do not collapse them into one generic method.
controls.risk_prevented: False equivalence between monitoring and calculation methods

controls.expected: A missing pollutant row may mean a reporting threshold was not reached; never convert absence to zero.
Keep below-reporting-threshold (brt) separate from not-applicable (n/a) and from numeric zero.
Apply the documented limit-of-detection rule only when source fields support it; preserve the 5 percent/20 percent exception and half-LOD treatment otherwise.
Retain annual mass and environmental medium (air, water or land) as distinct dimensions.
Record whether quantification used direct monitoring, emission factors, engineering calculation or mass balance; prefer site-specific evidence where documented.
Preserve operating-period scope and do not annualise partial-year values without explicit methodology.
Require a valid grid reference or coordinate before any spatial candidate is eligible for parcel matching.
Keep residual sector emissions mapped as area sources separate from individual installations.
Treat verified emissions, surrendered allowances and free allocation as separate fields; allocation is not measured emissions.
Registry account or operator identity is an identity candidate only; require an independent spatial match before parcel binding.
